answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer joins only if a sponsor stakes twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. A random beacon audits 5% each epoch; idle agents lose half their score. An ivory registry exposes clusters sharing one sponsor. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds plus upkeep, so a gale of fakes fails audits. An honest agent pays once, keeps its score by working, and earns undiluted rewards.
